audit_scope: Independent zero-operation preexecution review of the append-only r7 full-runtime and replay firewall package.

focused_r6_r7_tests.skip_reason: Windows symlink creation privilege unavailable; this does not override the blocking findings.

normal_parent_hold_graph.destination_breakdown: 58 static plus authorization, seal, and QA

blocking_findings.summary: The hidden worker can trust caller-authored private manifest, seal, PASS-QA, and authorized bytes without opening canonical live authorities or proving a true parent-child capability chain.
blocking_findings.evidence: The worker accepts copied runner, snapshot, and runtime roots plus caller-supplied digests. It does not retain canonical live authorization, QA, seal, and claim handles. A live PID is accepted without OS parent proof, and a caller can manually create a matching canonical claim.
blocking_findings.required_closure: Require fixed-path canonical live authority and claim handles, true OS parent PID and creation-time proof, and an inherited anonymous capability pipe or process handle whose 32-byte secret is never transported in CLI, environment, or manifest.

blocking_findings.summary: The worker calls ZoneInfo for Asia/Seoul before the isolated tzdata runtime is activated.
blocking_findings.evidence: The exact -I -S -B interpreter has an empty TZPATH and raises ZoneInfoNotFoundError. The canonical claim is created before worker startup, so the authorized one-shot would be consumed with zero fits.
blocking_findings.required_closure: Use epoch-nanosecond and bootstrap-safe operations only until the verified isolated runtime and tzdata are active; defer all KST formatting.

blocking_findings.summary: Live Python stdlib and an unsealed VC runtime execute before authentication.

evidence.additional_scope: PythonHome/Lib and root-level vcruntime140_1.dll are not covered by the r7 host inventory.

blocking_findings.required_closure: Launch from a fully isolated sealed Python home containing the executable, Python DLLs, complete stdlib, root VC runtimes, native dependency closure, and tzdata, or use an independently pinned native bootstrap. No live user-writable pre-auth code may execute.

blocking_findings.summary: Destination files are held but destination directories are not mutation-frozen during native loading.
blocking_findings.evidence: An undeclared dependent DLL can be inserted and execute before the next tree or memory-map verification.
blocking_findings.required_closure: Hold or ACL-freeze destination directories throughout native loading and add a real insertion adversarial test.

blocking_findings.summary: Manifest freshness, nonce, and parent identity are forgeable.
blocking_findings.evidence: There is no created<=now check, maximum launch age, exact nonce format and entropy check, nonce-reuse check, or true OS parent-child validation. A future created/deadline pair can extend the wall clock.
blocking_findings.required_closure: Capture execute-start at entry; enforce created<=now<deadline, a short maximum launch age, exactly 21600 seconds, monotonic supervision, and exactly 64 lowercase hex characters encoding a 32-byte nonce.

blocking_findings.summary: created_ns is captured after the full runtime copy rather than at parent execute entry.
blocking_findings.required_closure: Capture the authoritative start timestamp before copy and verification.

blocking_findings.summary: Several required copied-root, replay, nonce, deadline, and insertion checks are source-string assertions rather than end-to-end tests.
blocking_findings.required_closure: Add zero-fit end-to-end bootstrap and worker tests for every listed adversarial path and prove namespace byte-for-byte immutability.
